components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When present it
            prefixes the 'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' are supplied they are
            preferred and this field is returned as their normalized composition (the normalized
            'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when non-blank and normalized the same way. Optional, for backward
            compatibility with the flat 'address' form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended to
            'addressLine1' (separated by a single space) to compose the returned 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's
            region via the pinned region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A
            city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). When no
            country code is given, '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Acknowledgement that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. A household is keyed on last name and postcode, so a
            second owner with the same last name and postcode is otherwise rejected
            as a conflict. When true, the create request is allowed and the owner is
            recorded as a declared household member (and never flagged as a possible
            duplicate). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `checkDigit`.

**New single-responsibility helper**
- `util/MemberId.java` — builds `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (reusing `FiscalYear`, `Sha256.prefix`, and `CheckDigit` for the CHK over the `<REGION><FY><HASH8>` body), plus `dedupe(...)` for collision handling and `regionOf(...)` to recover the region (parsed from the fixed-length FY+HASH8+CHK tail, tolerant of the `-<n>` dedupe suffix).
- Deleted `util/CustomerCode.java` and `util/MembershipNumber.java`.

**Pipeline** (`owners.POST.yml`)
- `AssignCustomerCode` → `AssignMemberId` (now also uses the resolved registration date for FY), `DeduplicateCustomerCode` → `DeduplicateMemberId`. Collision handling now applies to the `memberId`.

**Entity & schema**
- `Owner.customerCode`/`customer_code` → `memberId`/`member_id`; bumped the column to `VARCHAR(32)` (hsqldb/h2/mysql; postgres is `TEXT`) since `UNKNOWN`-region ids plus a dedupe suffix are longer.

**Derived values now reference the memberId**
- `OwnerMapper`: dropped `membershipNumber` and `checkDigit`; `memberId` auto-maps. `locality` (and thus `timezone` and `ownerSegment`) now takes the region from `MemberId.regionOf`. `fiscalYear` keeps `FiscalYear` as sole formatter over the same value now embedded in the id.
- `PrimaryIdentifier.of` resolves to `memberId` (its designed switch point) → the `AuditOwnerCreated` line and the `OwnerCreatedEvent` (JSON key now `memberId`) both reference it.

**API contract** (`openapi.yml`) — replaced the three fields with a single `memberId` (which regenerates `OwnerDto`).

The one interpretation call worth flagging: the spec's "the fiscal-year value … must reference the memberId" — I kept the `fiscalYear` DTO field computed from the (business-day-adjusted) registration date rather than re-parsing it out of the id, since the FY value is identical and this keeps `FiscalYear` the single formatter and avoids fragile string-slicing. The fiscal-year's role has moved into the memberId (as its FY segment, replacing membershipNumber's `-M<YY>`). Region-derived values (owner segment) and the audit record do read from the memberId. If you'd prefer `fiscalYear` to also be sliced out of the id for strict symmetry, that's a one-line change.
